set.body: Per decision q-plan-coverage. NodeDef[P] with NodeId, Codec[P] and interpreter P => Op. Registration compile-time typed; only lookup is by identifier, and a miss is an explicit error naming node and version. HOLD THE RULE: node params are typed domain values, never Map[String,String]. An inexpressible operation is a missing node, not a reason to add a dynamic one.
set.title: Typed plan-node extension registry
